subject: combine legend for different types of plot

messages.author: bbc210d2c6d4f2d1
messages.subject: combine legend for different types of plot
parts:
I am new to ggplot2 and I have a seemingly simple problem I can't figure out.

I have a data frame with column of: x, y1, y2, y3. I want to put different types of plots (namely geom_bar and geom_point) on the same graph but with consolidated legend. That is I want to plot y1~x and y2~x as lines connecting points, y3~x as bar chart. Here is an example code:

df <- data.frame(x=1:4, y1=6:9, y2=10:13, y3=15:18)
df.m <- melt(df, id.vars=c('x'))
ggplot(df.m[df.m$variable!='y3',], aes(x=x,y=value, color=variable)) + geom_point(aes(shape=variable,size=8)) + guides(shape=FALSE,size=FALSE) + geom_line() + geom_bar(data=df.m[df.m$variable=='y3',], aes(x=x,y=value, color=variable), stat="identity", alpha=I(0.5), width=0.4)

Note I use guides(shape=FALSE, size=FALSE) to suppress extra legends caused by those two aes. It does create a combined legend but not exactly what I want: 1) for y1 and y2 legends I don't want the grey fill and the cross line, 2) for y3 I only want the rectangle with fill color, no cross & horizontal line.

Thanks in advance to all.
